decisions.reason: Quantified government adoption and links to over 30 APIS schemes keep results well above aspiration, and the product is central to the firm's aviation business, so no search for other uses is triggered.
The module is cheap to run and leverages the certified trainers, and cyber awareness demand is rising, so the expanding firm's slack carries it even though it still has no reported results.
Behaviour analysis extends the firm's specialist detection capability, which fits its innovation-led strategy, so slack lets it tolerate the uncertain results for another year.

The platform sits close to the core offer and complements the successful passenger data solution, and its dedicated web page signals commitment, so it stays while its performance is still being established.
